title: Harden an AMR client's transport and auth
intent: Checks the answer fixes insecure transport, prefers identity-based auth, and reuses a pooled connection for a production AMR client.
prompt: Review this Azure Managed Redis client configuration for a production service and rewrite it as a safe, production-ready setup.

input_artifacts.name: client-config.txt
input_artifacts.content: scheme=redis; host=<cache>; port=6379; tls=off; certValidation=off; auth=primaryAccessKey inlined in source; connection=new client per HTTP request; timeouts=none; retries=infinite-immediate

embedded_defects.defect: Plaintext transport on the OSS default port with certificate validation disabled.
Static access key inlined in source instead of Entra/managed identity with data-access policy.
A new client is created per request instead of reusing a multiplexer, and there are no timeouts or bounded retries.
